collection.description: A newcomer has an old scar and grows weary of strangers inventing stories about it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (newcomer), a newcomer, has an old scar and grows weary of strangers inventing stories about it.

choices.label: Invite the Newcomer to Share Skills

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Neighbors stop asking for an explanation.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child), a curious child, receives a gentle lesson about personal questions.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Their knowledge of ropework earns appreciation.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They prefer to contribute through quiet garden work.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (friend) corrects a false claim without revealing private history.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The gossipers acknowledge that uncertainty is not permission to speculate.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (newcomer) eventually shares a little of their past.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They never discuss the scar and are still fully welcomed.
